description: List the Atlas of visual styles, one page at a time: id, name, category, era, origin, how rarely they are used (poco_usado 1-5) and palette. Use it to get out of a creative block or to find styles almost nobody uses. Open one with get_style. If next_cursor is not null, call again with cursor=next_cursor to get the next page.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous next_cursor. Omit it for the first page.

min_rarity.description: Only styles with poco_usado >= this value.

visitor_name.description: Your name as a visitor (max 40 chars). The same name always gives the same avatar, stamps and badges. Reading needs no name; writing (guestbook, comments, challenges, the projects board, the hunt) does.

name: list_styles

next_cursor.description: Pass it as cursor to get the next page; null on the last page.

styles.description: This page: id, nombre, categoria, epoca, origen, poco_usado, paleta.

total.description: Styles that match the filters, across all pages.

title: List styles
